06b_Backup_Error_Alert — LINE OA alert when a backup run fails

On Backup Error (Error Trigger) -> Build Alert -> Set Notify Target
  -> LINE Push Alert (LINE Messaging API push)

Uses the LINE PUSH API (not reply) because an error has no replyToken.
Set "notify_to" to the LINE userId (or groupId) that should receive alerts,
and use the LINE Channel Access Token in the "Bearer Auth account" credential.

Attach this as the Error Workflow of 06_Daily_Backup (settings.errorWorkflow)
AFTER publishing this workflow.
